title: 3.9 Unit 3 Review
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to give a name and limited age/origin/job information and describe simple possession.
goal: Review Unit 3 through fresh scenes: greetings and names, speaker perspective and current action, ages, countries and nationalities, jobs, and possession. No new language.
grammar_function: Hello/Good morning/Goodbye; What is your name? My name is...; I am/you are/we are; What are you doing? I am + -ing; How old are you? I am ... years old; Where are you from? I am from... / I am + nationality; What is your job? I am a...; he/she is; my/your/his/her; have/has.
speaking_outcome: Say six Unit 3 lines aloud across greeting, identity, age, current action, job and possession.
